caption: The drawing features a square composition dominated by a red and beige color scheme. Inside the square, there is a large circular segment that takes up most of the bottom left and center areas. Within this circular segment, intricate floral patterns with flowers, leaves, and small berry-like dots are rendered in red against a beige background. The circular segment is bordered by a thick red outline, outside of which is a triangular grid pattern in the bottom right corner, consisting of alternating red and beige triangles. The background of the drawing, outside the circular segment, is filled with a red area adorned with small dotted patterns and vertical dashed lines, enhancing the texture. Near the lower right edge of the white surrounding margin, the signature "A. Chazlin" is visible.
